findings.issue: The List of Tables cites Table 3-3 on page 58, but the Table 3-3 caption begins on printed page 56 (PDF page 80), before Figure 3.4 intervenes; the listed page is the first row page, not the page where the table begins. This conflicts with the list’s stated convention: 'with the page on which it begins.'
findings.fix_instruction: Either move the Table 3-3 caption to printed page 58 so it matches the List of Tables, or correct the List of Tables entry to page 56 and state the page convention for captions split from table bodies.

findings.evidence: Contents (PDF p.7) lists: "5\nFrom Workload to Model Selection . . . 105". The chapter itself opens at PDF p.128 with "chapter 5.\nFrom Workload to Model Selection", which by the PDF's own pagination is printed page 104: the Ch 5 opening sits exactly 20 PDF pages before the Ch 6 opening, and the Ch 6 opening page (PDF p.148) carries the printed footer "124" while the Contents lists "6 Measuring What Matters: From Telemetry to Architecture Decisions . . . 124". Equivalently, Fig. 5.1 (Contents: "figure 5.1: Model selection for RAG ... 123") sits at PDF p.147, i.e. 19 PDF pages after the Ch 5 opening (PDF p.128), so Ch 5 spans printed pages 104–123 and begins on 104. Every other chapter/part entry I could check against the PDF's own footers matches: Part I = 1 (PDF p.25), Ch 1 = 2 (PDF p.26), Ch 2 = 16 (PDF p.40), Ch 3 = 39 (PDF p.63), Part II = 62 (PDF p.86), Ch 4 = 63 (PDF p.87), Part III = 140 (PDF p.164), Ch 7 = 141 (PDF p.165) — Ch 5 is the single off-by-one.
findings.issue: Stale/off-by-one page reference in the Table of Contents: Ch. 5 is listed at p. 105 but its opening page is p. 104, so the entry points one page past the chapter start (the implied Ch 5 length of 19 pages is wrong; it is 20 pages, 104–123). The same front-matter pagination pass should be re-run over the List of Figures and List of Tables, since the drift indicates the page-number generation for the front matter was not re-verified after a late insertion or deletion.
findings.fix_instruction: Re-generate the front-matter page references from the final pagination (Ch 5 → 104) and audit every Contents, List-of-Figures and List-of-Tables entry against the printed folios rather than against an earlier layout pass.
